d:
The OSC exam results are out… and so is the disappointment.
After a failed first attempt, Raviranjan is caught between his family’s taunts and Jyoti’s quiet frustration. Just when things hit rock bottom, Jyoti sparks an idea that might just help Ravi rewrite his story. But will he rise from this setback — or sink deeper into self-doubt?
Ye Saali Naukri is Dice Media’s brutally relatable web series about job pressure, dreams, and the grind that comes with chasing a sarkari naukri.
Presented by Dice Media & Civic Studios
A Civic Studios Original Production
